remarks: Searching for a home in Grand Island, NY with a fenced yard, attached garage, updated mechanicals, and flexible living space? Welcome to 1603 Love Road, where classic Cape Cod charm meets modern comfort.  Full basement for storage, hobbies, or future possibilities. With a new furnace and central air conditioning installed in 2025, you can enjoy year-round comfort from day one. Inside, you'll find a layout designed for both everyday living and entertaining. The spacious living room is anchored by a warm gas fireplace, creating an inviting place to gather on cooler evenings. The formal dining room features hardwood flooring and plenty of room for holidays and special occasions, while the generously sized kitchen offers abundant cabinetry, expansive counter space, and easy access to the bright sunroom. Filled with natural light, the sunroom provides a comfortable extension of the living space and overlooks the backyard, making it the perfect place to enjoy your morning coffee, read a book, or unwind at the end of the day. The first floor includes two comfortable bedrooms and a full bath, while the second floor serves as a private retreat with an expansive primary suite featuring its own full bathroom, walk-in closet, and sitting area—ideal for a home office, reading nook, or fitness space. Step outside to discover one of the property's standout features: a fully fenced backyard designed for enjoying every season. Whether you're hosting summer cookouts, gardening, relaxing with pets, or simply enjoying the outdoors, the yard offers both privacy and functionality. A convenient storage shed provides space for lawn equipment and seasonal items, while established berry bushes add charm and the enjoyment of harvesting fresh fruit right from your own backyard. The attached garage makes daily life easier by providing sheltered parking and additional storage, while the full basement offers exceptional utility space with laundry, mechanicals, and room for future projects or organization. 1603 Love Road is ready to welcome you home.
